title: Sol-Ark Modbus – Energy Accounting

targets.query:
import "date"
import "strings"
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "America/New_York")

historical = from(bucket:"${bucket}")
  |> range(start: 2026-01-18T00:00:00Z, stop: 2026-08-16T00:00:00Z)
  |> filter(fn:(r)=>r._measurement=="solark_energy_totals" and r.source=="solarassistant_backfill" and (r._field=="daily_load_kwh" or r._field=="daily_pv_kwh" or r._field=="daily_battery_charge_kwh" or r._field=="daily_battery_discharge_kwh" or r._field=="daily_grid_import_kwh" or r._field=="daily_grid_export_kwh"))
  |> filter(fn:(r)=>"${inverter}"=="System")
  |> aggregateWindow(every:1d,fn:max,createEmpty:false,timeSrc:"_start")
  |> map(fn:(r)=>({r with _field: if r._field=="daily_load_kwh" then "Load" else if r._field=="daily_pv_kwh" then "Solar PV" else if r._field=="daily_battery_charge_kwh" then "Battery charged" else if r._field=="daily_battery_discharge_kwh" then "Battery discharged" else if r._field=="daily_grid_import_kwh" then "Grid used" else "Grid exported"}))
  |> keep(columns:["_time","_value","_field"])

live = from(bucket:"${bucket}")
  |> range(start: 2026-08-16T00:00:00Z)
  |> filter(fn:(r)=>r._field=="value")
  |> filter(fn:(r)=>if "${inverter}"=="System" then (r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}1_daily_load_energy" or r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}2_daily_load_energy" or r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}1_daily_pv_energy" or r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}2_daily_pv_energy" or r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}1_daily_battery_charge_energy" or r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}2_daily_battery_charge_energy" or r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}1_daily_battery_discharge_energy" or r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}2_daily_battery_discharge_energy" or r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}1_daily_grid_import_energy" or r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}2_daily_grid_import_energy" or r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}1_daily_grid_export_energy" or r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}2_daily_grid_export_energy") else (r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}${inverter}_daily_load_energy" or r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}${inverter}_daily_pv_energy" or r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}${inverter}_daily_battery_charge_energy" or r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}${inverter}_daily_battery_discharge_energy" or r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}${inverter}_daily_grid_import_energy" or r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}${inverter}_daily_grid_export_energy"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every:1d,fn:max,createEmpty:false,timeSrc:"_start")
  |> map(fn:(r)=>({r with _field: if strings.hasSuffix(v:r.entity_id,suffix:"daily_load_energy") then "Load" else if strings.hasSuffix(v:r.entity_id,suffix:"daily_pv_energy") then "Solar PV" else if strings.hasSuffix(v:r.entity_id,suffix:"daily_battery_charge_energy") then "Battery charged" else if strings.hasSuffix(v:r.entity_id,suffix:"daily_battery_discharge_energy") then "Battery discharged" else if strings.hasSuffix(v:r.entity_id,suffix:"daily_grid_import_energy") then "Grid used" else "Grid exported"}))
  |> keep(columns:["_time","_value","_field"])
  |> group(columns:["_time","_field"])
  |> sum(column:"_value")

daily = union(tables:[historical,live])
  |> group(columns:["_time","_field"])
  |> sum(column:"_value")


daily
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"],columnKey:["_field"],valueColumn:"_value")
  |> fill(column:"Load",value:0.0)
  |> fill(column:"Solar PV",value:0.0)
  |> fill(column:"Battery charged",value:0.0)
  |> fill(column:"Battery discharged",value:0.0)
  |> fill(column:"Grid used",value:0.0)
  |> fill(column:"Grid exported",value:0.0)
  |> map(fn:(r)=>({r with Balance: float(v:r["Solar PV"])+float(v:r["Battery discharged"])+float(v:r["Grid used"])-float(v:r.Load)-float(v:r["Battery charged"])-float(v:r["Grid exported"])}))
  |> filter(fn:(r)=>r._time >= date.sub(d:30d,from:now()))
  |> sort(columns:["_time"],desc:true)
  |> limit(n:30)
